findings.claim: OC133-NOVELTY-001: Prior-art comparison supports bounded positioning of the OC release-governance bundle; uniqueness is not promoted.
findings.failure_mode: The register asserts PRIOR_ART_PREDATES_OC while several source_date fields are only "reference" and one is "2026". Those rows do not establish dated priority before the OC 1.3.3 release date, so the priority portion of the source-backed comparator is not actually source-backed.
findings.required_repair: Replace every undated or same-year priority anchor with exact pre-OC publication or revision dates and source excerpts, or change those rows to an undated-reference status and demote OC133-NOVELTY-001 until dated priority is established.

findings.claim: OC133-NOVELTY-001: Prior-art comparison supports bounded positioning of the OC release-governance bundle; uniqueness is not promoted.
findings.failure_mode: The absence tests are mostly assertions such as NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE_PAGE or prose statements that a single source page does not present the combined bundle. They include no exact inspected text, query terms, source snapshots, hashes, or element-level negative checks, so they support only a narrow page-level note, not a release-critical source-backed residual delta across the named traditions.
findings.required_repair: Add per-row source excerpts for overlap, explicit searched terms/sections for absence, archived source snapshots or hashes, and an element-by-element comparison for the claim/proof/data/falsifier/no-send bundle; otherwise demote the claim to cited-page positioning only.

findings.claim: T133-KLEVEL: Every adjacent K-level transition K0->K12 has a witness, a reduction-failure criterion, and a lawful demotion criterion.
findings.failure_mode: The finite-model evaluator accepts K-level witnesses from row booleans such as witness_retained, added_axis_observable, demotion_allowed, and reduction_attempt. It does not independently verify added_axis, witness_pair, reduction_failure_criterion, or lawful_demotion_criterion against the atlas or prior-art sources, so the passing result is self-confirming theorem theater rather than evidence of irreducibility.
findings.required_repair: Make the runner load and cross-check the K-level atlas against every finite row, require executable countermodels for each transition, and demote T133-KLEVEL to a declared synthetic witness schema until the transition evidence is independently validated.

findings.claim: T133-OMEGA-STATUS: Live status, death, residue, and rebirth are distinct typed predicates and morphism classes.
findings.failure_mode: The promoted Lean reference for this theorem is declared_death_blocks_live, which only proves inconsistency between live=true and live=false under declared death assumptions. It does not cover residue/rebirth separation, typed predicate non-interchangeability, or morphism-class distinctness for the full public claim.
findings.required_repair: Split the claim into separately promoted subclaims with matching Lean refs and finite cases, or add a theorem and finite witnesses that explicitly cover live, death, residue, rebirth, and identity/morphism separation before promoting the combined claim.
